content.comment_body: Hello all, is it possible to use [product_name] PLC as a Modbus or SNMP slave?

Hi, [product_name] provides support for Modbus TCP/IP both as client and server. SNMP is not supported by [product_name]. As for [product_name], Modbus TCP/IP should be compatible, enabling data exchange between [product_name] and [product_name]. Hope that clarifies.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are questioning the protocol capabilities of [product_name] PLC, aiming to understand its support for Modbus and SNMP slave functions. The responses indicate that Modbus TCP/IP is supported as both client and server, whereas SNMP is not available. Reference is also made to interoperability with [product_name] using Modbus TCP/IP.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] PLC to handle both Modbus and SNMP slave protocols for straightforward integration with various networked systems and SCADA platforms.
